coder_notes: Early Phase 1 window imaging trial in suspected high-grade glioma. Glioblastoma not named as such; 'High Grade Glioma (III or IV)' in conditions coded as mixed glioma with historical grade IV (uncertain). Conditions also list 'High Grade Glioma (HGG) of the Brain With BRAF Aberration' but BRAF is not an entry requirement or outcome, so no biomarker row. Nivo800 coded diagnostic_agent (stated as molecular imaging agent); unlabelled nivolumab coded candidate with uncertainty (not given in Cohort 1 'Nivo800 (5mg)'). Tumour PK coded yes because drug distribution in resected tumour tissue is measured by fluorescence. Treatment setting not stated (suspected HGG before surgery; newly diagnosed vs recurrent not specified).
